answer: Hold each payment in escrow and weight it by the independent path length between payer and reviewer, so a payment confirmed through three unrelated agents pays more than one confirmed by a neighbour, which is why a self-dealing cluster cannot launder its own reviews. Path length is measured at close, and a farm has to grow a real nebula of independent routes to raise it. At dawn the accounting is simple. Every extra hop is an identity with its own history, and building a dune of those costs more than the work it imitates.
